description: Implementation of RpcWithAutograd class handling serialization, deserialization, and message creation for autograd RPC messages in PyTorch distributed autograd.

classes.name: RpcWithAutograd
classes.description: Class representing an RPC message with autograd information, supporting serialization and deserialization.

methods.name: toMessageImpl
methods.description: Serializes the RpcWithAutograd object into a Message for transmission.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Deserializes a Message into an RpcWithAutograd object.

methods.name: tensors
methods.description: Returns a reference to the tensors associated with this RPC message.

methods.name: autogradMetadata
methods.description: Returns the autograd metadata associated with this RPC message.

methods.name: wrappedRpc
methods.description: Returns a reference to the wrapped RPC command.

methods.name: moveWrappedRpc
methods.description: Moves and returns the wrapped RPC command.

methods.name: wrappedMessageType
methods.description: Returns the message type of the wrapped message.

methods.name: fromWorkerId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the worker that sent this message.

methods.name: deviceMap
methods.description: Returns the device map associated with this RPC message.
